name: create_danmaku_report
description: Render a private HTML report from owned query_danmaku evidence. sections_json is an array of up to 6 topics with title,observation,recommendation,sample_ids. When analysis.audience exists, classify audience.corpus IDs, each ID at most once; recommendation may be empty. Optional video_context requires supplied same-video video_evidence_id and video_at_ms (up to 4 actual sampled timestamps). Server computes topic counts, coverage, playback statistics and interaction ranking; do not invent counts. Without audience use 1-4 legacy sample IDs per section. Empty array is valid for insufficient data. Report success delivers the answer and ends the run.
